normalization: TypeScript null maps to a named typed error; original null remains in source.result.
Collections are sorted by id for comparison; membership and full account contents remain asserted.
DB/update outputs explicitly map accepted full-user lists/void to metadata reconciliation reports.
Internal plan/directory generation fields and serialized aggregate maintenance are excluded; account values, membership and credential side effects remain asserted.
Native diagnostic payloads use explicit caller context; source stack caller presence and native caller/channel/action are separately asserted.
gaps: Provider transport retries are covered by the separate token lifecycle suite; this suite compares OAuth use while preserving the source fetch-attempt count.
The injected native identity sink checks publication requests; production PostHog transport and dedup adapter require the optional posthog profile.
No live store adapters, real OAuth provider, cancellation scheduling, or cross-process Redis atomicity are exercised by these in-memory differential fixtures.
